LOOSE OPAQUE HIGH TURTLENECK LONG-SLEEVED jumper covers neckline and all upper chest, with generous fabric so no chest or torso contour; no low cut, open collar, sleeveless outfit or exposed upper chest. Plain light ivory studio; neutral daylight, sharp face and ALL hair detail, sufficient depth of field; no deliberate blur, bokeh, grain, fog or defocus filter. Natural skin texture, restrained premium salon colour. No text, logos, watermark, jewellery, celebrity likeness, stock or competitor reference. Preserve full source aspect. Design: compact rounded | textured tapered | full | ear-revealing temple pieces | 0-crown-to-front-proportion. Neutral warm stone setting, natural skin, soft studio daylight, full head/hair/ears/nape visible without crop. Fully covered modest outfit, closed high neckline, long sleeves, no exposed shoulders, chest or back. Portrait 4:5, no words, watermark or logos. Do not substitute an ordinary bob, close pixie or long wolf cut. Render a clearly distinct haircut concept rather than only changing colour or model age. FRONT view: face directly forward and level, both eyes and full front haircut outline visible, no three-quarter turn. Quiet natural expression. Hair/cut attributes in this brief are authoritative; clothing rule is high loose opaque turtleneck.
STRICT FINAL COMPOSITION: a single shoulders-only portrait, bottom edge just below shoulder tops; a BULKY LOOSE OPAQUE HIGH TURTLENECK conceals neckline and chest completely. No visible chest shape. Keep entire hair outline with generous blank border. All native hair detail sharp. Hair strands must be genuinely STRAIGHT, without curls or loose waves; follow the planned crown, fringe, and taper.
